t: Mastering Excel Workflows: Data Structures, Debugging, and AI Collaboration
s: This article explores Excel's .xlsx format, the legacy of row-column data structures (Fortran, Pandas) versus key-value stores, and the practicalities of debugging data-intensive applications with AI assistance. It highlights Python's dominance in tabular data due to optimized C/Fortran libraries and contrasts columnar vs. row storage formats.
